head: Regel
Voorbeeld
rows: zonder persoon, of met to + persoon
She said (that) she was tired. She said to me that ...
altijd met een persoon direct erachter
She told me (that) she was tired.
tell the truth, tell a lie, tell a story, tell the time

blocks.title: Hij zei me = He told me
blocks.text: Het Nederlandse zeggen en vertellen passen niet precies op say en tell. Onthoud: als er direct een persoon volgt, gebruik je tell: He told me, nooit He said me.
Na een werkwoord in het verleden (said, told, asked) zet je de tijd meestal een stap terug. Ook voornaamwoorden en tijdwoorden veranderen.

head: Wat iemand zei
Indirect
Tijd
rows: She said she had seen the film.
She said she would call me.

blocks.title: Wanneer niet terugzetten?
blocks.text: Is het nog steeds waar, dan mag de tijd blijven: She said she lives in Leiden (ze woont er nog). En na een werkwoord in de tegenwoordige tijd verandert er niets: He says he's busy.
In een indirecte vraag staat de gewone woordvolgorde (onderwerp – werkwoord), zonder do, does of did en zonder vraagteken. Ja/nee-vragen krijgen if of whether.

head: Directe vraag
Indirect
Nederlands
rows: He asked me where I lived.
She asked if I was hungry.
Zij vroeg of ik honger had.
Can you tell me what time it is?
Kunt u me zeggen hoe laat het is?
They asked whether I had seen him.
Zij vroegen of ik hem had gezien.

blocks.title: of = if of whether
blocks.text: Het Nederlandse of in een indirecte vraag is if of whether, niet or: Ik weet niet of hij komt = I don't know if he's coming.

head: Direct
Indirect
Nederlands
rows: She asked me to help her.
Zij vroeg me haar te helpen.
He told us to sit down.
Hij zei dat we moesten gaan zitten.
My boss told me not to be late.
Mijn baas zei dat ik niet te laat moest komen.
He said me that he was ill.
He told me that he was ill.
She asked me where did I live.
She asked me where I lived.
Indirecte vraag: geen did, gewone volgorde.
Can you tell me where is the station?
Can you tell me where the station is?
Indirecte vraag: onderwerp vóór het werkwoord.
He told that he was tired.
He said that he was tired.
She asked me or I wanted tea.
She asked me if I wanted tea.
Of in een indirecte vraag: if.
He told me don't touch it.
He told me not to touch it.

blocks.text: Vul het ontbrekende woord in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.full: She told me she was leaving.

items.q: He ______ that he didn't like fish.
items.full: He said that he didn't like fish.
"I'm busy." — She said she was busy.

items.q: "I'll help you." — He said he ______ help me.
items.full: "I'll help you." — He said he would help me.

items.q: "I saw it." — She said she ______ seen it.
items.full: "I saw it." — She said she had seen it.

items.q: He asked me ______ I was married.
items.full: He asked me if I was married.

items.q: Can you tell me where the toilets ______?
items.full: Can you tell me where the toilets are?

items.q: She asked me ______ close the window.
items.full: She asked me to close the window.

items.q: The doctor told me ______ to eat too much sugar.
items.full: The doctor told me not to eat too much sugar.

items.q: "I can drive." — He said he ______ drive.
items.full: "I can drive." — He said he could drive.

items.q: I don't know ______ she will come.
items.full: I don't know if she will come.

items.q: Hij zei dat hij moe was.
Zij vroeg me waar ik woonde.
items.a: She asked me where I lived.

items.q: Ik weet niet of hij komt.
items.a: I don't know if he's coming.

items.q: Mijn moeder vroeg me haar te helpen.
items.a: My mother asked me to help her.
